verdict.rationale: Databricks documents a Marketplace whose listings include datasets from its partner ecosystem, and customers can discover, evaluate, and connect to them directly from their workspace. That covers the core of finding third-party datasets inside the platform. The evidence never shows the enrichment step, such as joining or querying acquired data alongside the user's own tables, and has no hands-on corroboration, so coverage is partial. Missing for 10: documented in-platform enrichment or joining of marketplace data with the user's own data, details on how acquired datasets land in Unity Catalog for querying, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an analyst, a marketplace of third-party datasets lets me enrich my own data directly inside the platform

citations.quote: Listings include datasets, AI models, notebooks, apps, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.
publish offerings that Databricks customers can discover, evaluate, and connect with directly from their workspace
This gives customers a single catalog for finding data, software, and AI capabilities across the Databricks partner ecosystem.
